provider_payload_notes.machine_id: Controller joins authoritative REST machineId to RUNPOD_POD_ID; E025_MACHINE_ID is never fabricated from Pod ID.
provider_payload_notes.provider_side_ttl: runpodctl exposes --terminate-after, but REST v1 create does not. The chosen REST lifecycle therefore requires the independent watchdog.
